meta.title: The Reading Place
meta.description: A personal book shelf you own.

landing.title: Track, share, and discover your next great read
landing.subtitle: The Reading Place helps you organize your bookshelf, stay on top of what you are reading, and share recommendations with friends.
landing.featureOrganizeDescription: Log books, statuses, formats, dates, and notes in one place.
landing.featureConnectDescription: Share shelves with friends and see what they are reading.
landing.featureImportDescription: Bring your Goodreads library over in just a few clicks.

shelf.reviewPromptDescription: Share a quick thought about this book. You can always edit it later.

newBook.title: Add a book
newBook.subtitle: Only the title is required. Everything else is optional.

barcodeScanner.scanHint: Point the camera at the barcode on the back of the book.
barcodeScanner.permissionDenied: Camera access is blocked. You can allow it in your browser settings, or type the ISBN instead.
barcodeScanner.cameraUnavailable: No camera is available on this device. Type the ISBN instead.
barcodeScanner.notFound: No book found for that code.

friends.title: Friends
friends.subtitle: Connect with readers you know.
friends.noneYet: None yet. Send an invite to get started.
friends.newMemberLinkDescription: One-shot link. Send it to someone who does not have an account yet.
friends.inviteAGroupHelper: Two ways to grow your circle: invite someone you know, or send a one-shot link to a new reader.
friends.sentNone: You have not sent any invitations yet.

addToShelf.title: Add to my shelf
addToShelf.description: Choose a status for this book.

import.title: Import from Goodreads
import.subtitle: Upload your Goodreads CSV export to import your reading history.
import.instructions: To get your CSV file from Goodreads, sign in and go to My Books, then click Import and export in the left sidebar. Under Export Library, click Export to CSV and wait for the file to download.
import.dropzoneText: Drag and drop your CSV file here, or
import.importComplete: Import complete! {imported} book(s) imported, {skipped} skipped (duplicates), {errors} error(s).
import.parseError: Failed to parse CSV file. Please check the format.

claimUsername.title: Choose a username
claimUsername.subtitle: Friends will invite you with this handle.

invite.invalid: This invite link is no longer valid.
invite.existing: This invite link is only for new accounts. You already have an account.

errors.shelfAccessDenied: You do not have access to this shelf.
errors.receiverRequired: Pick a friend to recommend to.
errors.cannotRecommendSelf: You cannot recommend a book to yourself.
errors.notFriends: You can only recommend to accepted friends.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.subtitle: Books your friends think you would like.
recommendations.noSent: You have not recommended any books yet.
recommendations.panelDescription: Pick an accepted friend and add an optional personal note.
recommendations.noFriends: You do not have any accepted friends to recommend to yet.
recommendations.acceptDescription: Choose a status for this book on your shelf.
recommendations.dismissDescription: You can add an optional response for @{username}.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.subtitle: Reading insights for your shelf.

statistics.warningWithCount_plural: {count} of your finished books in this period don't have a page count. Add them for a more accurate total.
statistics.empty: No books finished in this period yet.

share.title: Share your shelf
share.description: Mint a link anyone can open, even without an account.
share.enabledNotice: Anyone with this link can view your shelf. Rotate it to invalidate.
share.buttonTooltip: Open the share panel to mint, rotate, or disable the public link
